Container.Name: Ferrite
Container.Overview: Ferrite is a self-hosted DNS filter and router for the home network. It blocks ads, trackers and malware for every device; applies per-device profiles — blocked services such as TikTok or Roblox, weekly schedules, SafeSearch and YouTube Restricted Mode, default-deny; and sends chosen domains, services or devices through built-in WireGuard (kernel-backed for line-rate throughput where the host allows it, in-process userspace otherwise), SOCKS5/Tor or a DPI-evasion path. Encrypted upstreams (DoH/DoT/DoQ), a live query log and per-device activity, notifications to ntfy, Telegram, Discord or a webhook, and a REST API — one Rust binary, configured from its web panel.
Container.Requires: Ports 53 TCP/UDP and 80 TCP must be available on the selected Unraid network/IP; the selective-routing (tunnels) feature additionally needs 443 TCP reachable unmapped. A custom Docker network or fixed IP (br0) is recommended: the Unraid web UI often already uses host ports 80/443, and routed domains require clients to reach Ferrite on the real ports 80/443. All Ferrite config, SQLite data, blocklist cache, snapshots, and web assets are stored under /mnt/user/appdata/ferrite. The template grants NET_BIND_SERVICE (to bind port 53 without running as root) and NET_ADMIN (for kernel-mode WireGuard tunnels: Ferrite creates its own wg interface over netlink and routes only its own traffic through it, never touching the host routing table). Kernel mode also needs the wireguard module on the Unraid host, which is present on 6.9 and newer; without it Ferrite falls back to the userspace tunnel automatically and logs which backend it picked.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Stores Ferrite config, SQLite database, blocklist cache, snapshots, and web assets.

Config.Name: DNS TCP
Config.Description: DNS TCP listener for name resolution.

Config.Name: DNS UDP
Config.Description: DNS UDP listener for name resolution.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Ferrite API and web UI. Also intercepts HTTP for routed domains (demultiplexed by Host header).

Config.Name: HTTPS Routing
Config.Description: HTTPS (SNI) intercept for the selective-routing/tunnels feature. Only bound while routing is enabled. Must stay 443:443 for routing to work; leave unmapped if tunnels are not used.

Config.Name: Server Release Version
Config.Description: Use latest to install the newest Ferrite release on container start. Set a fixed version, for example 0.1.1, to disable automatic server release updates on restart.

Config.Name: Web Release Version
Config.Description: Optional web UI release version. Leave blank to follow Server Release Version; set a fixed version to pin the web UI separately.

Config.Name: Panel IP
Config.Description: Optional LAN IP for the built-in fe.te A record. In bridge networking set this to the Unraid host IP, for example 192.168.1.5. Leave blank to auto-detect.

Config.Name: Panel Domain
Config.Description: Optional override for the built-in panel shortcut domain. Leave blank for the default fe.te.

Config.Name: Panel URL
Config.Description: Optional startup-log URL for the panel shortcut. If Web UI is mapped to a non-80 host port, set this to http://fe.te:<port>.

Config.Name: GitHub Release Token
Config.Description: Optional GitHub token used when the container downloads server and web releases on start. Leave blank for public releases. Set a token only if you hit GitHub API rate limits (anonymous requests are capped at 60/hour per IP) or pull from a private mirror.
